fact: The Ethiopian Institution of the Ombudsman's home page offers a 'Submit Complaint' service to file administrative grievances online and track response status, with no count of complaints received through it.
system: Fast Access Portal (Ethiopian Institution of the Ombudsman)

fact: Ethiopian Investment Holdings launched the online platform Adera in January 2026 for citizens to report complaints and corruption at the state-owned enterprises it manages, with mobile apps planned later; no case numbers are given.

The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that it has a platform for citizens to give feedback on service delivery, naming the e-complaint portal ecompliant.gov.et; no launch date or case count is given, so the as_of is the survey round's year.
